steps.title: Configure App Manifest Requirements
steps.description: Integrate package details, set screen orientations, and specify launch-ready entry points.

steps.title: Verify Java 8 Constraints
steps.description: Validate that no lambda syntax or streams are present in source files, replacing them with traditional anonymous inner classes.

steps.title: Review Android Namespace Authenticity
steps.description: Double check standard XML namespaces inside layout structures and AndroidManifest configurations.

steps.title: Building Creative Studio
steps.description: Run native build tool instructions to pack, assemble, and optimize debug apk output.
